name: astra-db
summary: It manages database collections and records, creating, updating, deleting, searching, and counting them.

tools.name: BulkCreateRecords
tools.description: Create multiple records in a collection at once

collectionName.description: Name of the collection to create the records in

tools.name: BulkDeleteRecords
tools.description: Delete multiple records from a collection at once

recordIds.description: Array of record IDs to delete

collectionName.description: Name of the collection containing the records

tools.name: BulkUpdateRecords
tools.description: Update multiple records in a collection at once

id.description: ID of the record to update

records.description: Array of records to update with their IDs

collectionName.description: Name of the collection containing the records

tools.name: CreateCollection
tools.description: Create a new collection in the database

metric.description: The similarity metric to use for vector search (cosine, euclidean, or dot_product)

vector.description: Whether to create a vector collection

dimension.description: The dimensions of the vector collection, if vector is true

collectionName.description: Name of the collection to create

tools.name: CreateRecord
tools.description: Create a new record in a collection

collectionName.description: Name of the collection to create the record in

tools.name: DeleteCollection
tools.description: Delete a collection from the database

collectionName.description: Name of the collection to delete

tools.name: DeleteRecord
tools.description: Delete a record from a collection

recordId.description: ID of the record to delete

collectionName.description: Name of the collection containing the record

tools.name: EstimateDocumentCount
tools.description: Estimate the number of documents in a collection using a fast, approximate count method

collectionName.description: Name of the collection to estimate document count for

tools.name: FindDistinctValues
tools.description: Find distinct values for a field in a collection

field.description: Field name to find distinct values for

filter.description: Optional filter to apply before finding distinct values

collectionName.description: Name of the collection to search in

tools.name: FindRecord
tools.description: Find records in a collection by field value

field.description: Field name to search by (e.g., 'title', '_id', or any property)

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return

value.description: Value to search for in the specified field

collectionName.description: Name of the collection to search in

tools.name: GetCollections
tools.description: Get all collections in the Astra DB database

tools.name: GetRecord
tools.description: Get a specific record from a collection by ID

recordId.description: ID of the record to retrieve

collectionName.description: Name of the collection to get the record from

tools.name: HelpAddToClient
tools.description: Help the user add the Astra DB client to their MCP client

tools.name: HybridSearch
tools.description: Search for records using both vector similarity and text matching

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return

fields.description: Fields to search in for text matching

weights.description: Weights for vector and text components

textQuery.description: The text query to search for

queryVector.description: The vector to search for similar vectors

collectionName.description: Name of the collection to search in

tools.name: ListRecords
tools.description: List records from a collection in the database

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return

collectionName.description: Name of the collection to list records from

tools.name: OpenBrowser
tools.description: Open a web browser to a specific URL

url.description: The URL to open in the browser

tools.name: UpdateCollection
tools.description: Update an existing collection in the database

collectionName.description: Name of the collection to update

tools.name: UpdateRecord
tools.description: Update an existing record in a collection

recordId.description: ID of the record to update

collectionName.description: Name of the collection containing the record

tools.name: VectorSearch
tools.description: Search for records in a collection using vector similarity

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return

filter.description: Additional filter criteria for the search

queryVector.description: The vector to search for similar vectors

collectionName.description: Name of the collection to search in
